About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
●Participate in the research, development, and implementation of visual content generation technologies for game marketing and game development scenarios, including but not limited to image/video Ads Creatives generation, playable Ads generation, game asset generation, and game scene generation.
●Evaluate and track cutting-edge multimodal generative models (such as Flux, Qwen, Sora, and Wan series), continuously improving generation quality and efficiency.
●Build a complete visual content generation pipeline—from data processing and model training to inference and service deployment—to support the production needs of content teams.
●Explore innovative applications of generative AI based on business requirements, such as character-generation tools, automated video editing, dynamic promotional material generation, and more.

Who We Look For
●Master’s degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Graphics, Machine Learning, or related fields. Candidates with backgrounds in visual arts, film production, animation design, digital media, or other interdisciplinary fields are also welcome.
●At least 2 years of relevant experience in Ads Creative(image or video) generation, with hands-on experience in training or fine-tuning deep learning models in these domains. Proficiently use tools such as Sora2, Jimeng, Keling, Nano Banana, and ChatGPT 4o. Familiar with ComfyUI and WebUI for building private workflows.
●Prior experience in the gaming or animation industries is preferred.
●Over 1,000 hours of gaming experience within the past three years is a strong plus.
●Strong sensitivity to visual style or formal training in fine arts is preferred.
●Passion for AI creativity and game-oriented applications; candidates with an AI video portfolio will be prioritised.
●Familiarity with tools such as Maya, Blender, Unity, and Unreal Engine is a significant advantage.

Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

As a Senior CG Generalist within Level Infinite’s internal creative studio, you will be a cornerstone of our visual storytelling. You will navigate both real-time (UE5) and pre-rendered workflows to create world-class content across a diverse portfolio of titles and genres. Our work is across creative co-development through to high-profile marketing content. 
This role requires a rare blend of high-level technical execution and "emotional intelligence." You aren't just an artist; you are a mentor and a collaborator who helps define the artistic worldview of our games while maturing the talent within our Singapore-based CGI team. You will be responsible for raising the bar in character rendering, key art, and general asset creation.Lead the game CGI and 3D output of the studio
Create premium quality 3D Artisrty and concepts that execute on the vision of our projects
Source captivating game visual content using in-game assets and from-scratch models
Manage the structure, workload and running of CGI projects
Assemble sequences into cohesive edits
Utilise Pre-rendered and Realtime workflows to achieve your goals
Demonstrate creative problem-solving in addressing issues with incomplete game assets
Team with the ICC leadership across all work and clients
Keep up to date with creative technologies, AI advances and game-engines
Build skills in creative storytelling that encompass cinematography, lighting and editing
Mentor and elevate the 3D skills of the wider team
Collaborate with the rest of the Executive team to constantly improve and grow the Studio

Who We Look For
Experience: +8 years of cinematic or CG work in Games, Film, or high-end Entertainment
Artistic Eye: A demonstrable "artistic eye" for detail, cinematics, and high-quality production
Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in UE5  (Sequencer, lighting, animation, and cameras)
Expertise in 3D Character Art: including modelling, texturing, shading and grooming
Pipeline Knowledge: such as Maya, Zbrush, Metahuman, Texturing XYZ, and Adobe Substance 3D Painter
Leadership: Proven experience in mentoring teams and leading specific project verticals (e.g., environment or character teams)
Problem Solving: Strong creative problem-solving, particularly in addressing technical bottlenecks
Attributes: Highly mature, emotionally intelligent, and capable of giving/receiving feedback with professional grace.
Industry Passion: A deep affinity for video games, film, and the creative industries.

About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
As a Senior Technical Artist within Level Infinite’s internal creative studio, you are the critical bridge between artistic vision and technical execution. You will design and implement the technical foundations that allow our artists to deliver world-class cinematics and marketing content across a diverse portfolio of AAA titles.
You are a generalist problem-solver, comfortable navigating Unreal Engine 5 as well as various proprietary game engines to ensure high-fidelity visual assets are production-ready, scalable, and efficiently integrated across all projects. This role will support a rare combination of traditional pre-rendered workflows and cutting-edge Realtime technologies. An ideal candidate will be someone with a background in Cinematics or CGI moving content.Design, implement, and maintain efficient, high-performance art pipelines across Unreal Engine 5 and proprietary engines
Develop custom procedural tools and scripts (Python, Blueprints, Houdini) to automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual workload for the ICC artists
Profile and optimize performance for both real-time and pre-rendered workflows, ensuring visual assets meet high-fidelity benchmarks for trailers and key art
Author shader networks and material functions that execute on the creative vision of our projects across different engine environments
Demonstrate creative problem-solving by addressing technical bottlenecks and issues with incomplete, buggy, or non-standardized game assets
Act as the primary technical contact between internal artists, studios and external vendors to solve complex integration problems
Document progress and findings regularly and add to the growing knowledge base of the team
Appraise, rig, construct and consult on a variety of game assets to help both the team’s output and Studio production
Nurture an interest in simulations like coth sims, water and destruction

Who We Look For
Experience: +6  years of technical art experience in Games with a history of shipping high-profile titles.
Artistic Eye: A demonstrable "artistic eye" for detail and high-quality production, ensuring technical solutions never compromise aesthetic goals.
Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in Unreal Engine 5 (Sequencer, lighting, animation, and cameras).
Strong knowledge of proprietary engines and the ability to adapt to new technical environments quickly.
Experience in 3D Character Art pipelines, including modelling, texturing, and grooming
Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Blueprints, or C#.
Problem Solving: Exceptional creative problem-solving skills, particularly in addressing complex technical bottlenecks in shifting production environments.
Attributes: Mature, selfless and capable of giving and receiving feedback with professional grace.
Industry Passion: A deep affinity for video games, film, and the pursuit of technical excellence.

团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1.负责内容生态统筹运营，建立市场化的运作机制，制定短期及长期规划方案；
2.搭建并有效落地达人（签约）孵化策略及合作管理机制；
3.挖掘平台合作机会点，提升达人数据表现；
4.结合平台热点和产品特性，进行直播创意策划，提升直播内容的吸引力和传播力。

岗位要求
1.本科及以上学历，3年以上工作经验，具备成熟游戏产品生态统筹经验；
2.熟悉媒体平台内容及热点与流量机制，有网感，有账号孵化经验者优先；
3.热爱游戏，对PC游戏有较深理解，对刷子类游戏/SOC类游戏有深度经验者优先；
4.抗压能力强，有多线程任务处理能力，具备主人翁意识；
5.逻辑性较好，沟通与表达能力较好。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

Business Unit

As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Finance & Technology (FiT) Singapore is looking for a Business Development Manager / Senior Business Development Manager to join our team and participate in building and growing Tencent’s global cross-border payment network with key industry players.
What you will be doing:
Identify business development and partnership opportunities across the APAC region to build up Tencent’s global cross-border payment network in the 1）Wallet & Payment space and 2) Remittance Space.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of assigned partner portfolios, covering both Business Development (BD) and Account Management (AM), from partner onboarding and go-live through to post-launch growth and transaction volume expansion
Formulate customer expansion strategies and tactics according to business goals, including prospecting of customers, deal structuring & negotiation, customer onboarding, project go-live and ongoing relationship management.
Utilize diversified integrated marketing methods such as joint marketing with partners, brand advertising, offline exhibition marketing, content/case marketing, etc., to help improve business brand influence and industry reputation.
Coordinate with multiple internal functions including legal and compliance, operations and product teams to project manage all aspects of the partnership process and ensure efficient execution.
Architect scalable sales and partnership processes, including pipeline management, deal governance, cross-functional workflow optimization and post-launch performance tracking.

Who We Look For
Bachelor degree or above in Business/Finance/Economics/Computer Science or related field, with strong interest in developing a career in the FinTech payment space.
4- 8 years of experience in serving major customers in the financial industry; experience in cross-border payment industry is preferred.
Strong understanding of sales strategy development, pipeline management and commercial structuring.
Experience in process design or operational improvement within a matrix organization is a plus.
Have extensive network resources and experience in the cross-border payment space.
Excellent team management capabilities, project management and resource coordination capabilities, with the ability to effectively accelerate implementation of cooperation projects.
Highly self-driven and passionate about fintech and payments.
Eagerness to continuously drive process improvement.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin is preferred to facilitate effective coordination with HQ and cross-regional stakeholders.

部署紹介/Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS は、物語性の高いストーリー、没入感のあるゲームプレイ、最先端のテクノロジーを駆使し、ゲーム開発をアートとサイエンスの融合として追求し続けています。世界中のプレイヤー、そしてあらゆるデバイスに次世代のゲームエクスペリエンスを提供することを使命としています。
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
Working with scientists to research and develop advanced techniques in the following topics:
3D geometric learning, 
Re-meshing and UV optimization,
Physically-based animation and simulation
Machine learning for computer graphics
Motion planning in virtual city
Character locomotion and control
realistic image synthesis and real-time rendering techniques
Researching and developing tools and pipelines to facilitate the use of technologies in the game development environment

応募資格/Who We Look For
Strong coding skills in one of following programming languages: C++, python, TensorFlow/Torch
Solid knowledge in calculus, linear algebra, basic numerical analysis
A strong sense of responsibility and good communication skills

Plus:
Graduate students in a master or Ph.D. level program
Publications on computer graphics/vision, machine learning, and robotics
Familiarity with game engine, graphics APIs, and GPU programming

英文流利，能用于工作语言。
有海外游戏发行经验，了解海外重点社媒平台的内容和爆款逻辑，对海外流行趋势及热梗有敏锐触觉，能将热点内容转化为创意，积极主动，乐于探索新鲜事物，善用前沿工具。
具备较强业务增长导向，具备良好的数据与用研意识，能够将各类传播效果与产品数据增长相关联，注重以营销提升产品数据表现 。
热爱游戏，是游戏玩家，能从玩家角度拆解产品乐趣点，具备BR\FPS或其他游戏品类的深度体验经验优先 。

1.5年及以上工作经验，有丰富的游戏经验，有网红推广、视频、直播、同人等内容创作经验者优先；
2.有敏锐的游戏和娱乐触觉，善于捕捉创新形式和内容话题热点； 具有良好的运营意识，较强的逻辑思维能力与数据分析能力；

4.熟悉YouTube、Twitch、Instagram、Facebook、Twitter、Tiktok等平台玩法和推荐机制者更佳；
5.有较强的抗压能力及自我驱动能力，有极强的工作责任心和团队合作精神。
6.有带领团队经验者更佳。

Background:Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Communications, or related fields. 5+ years of experience in Big Data; prior experience with Tier1 Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) is highly preferred.

Soft Skills: Excellent logical thinking, communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-cultural and high-pressure environment.
